stage0067_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「We broke through the defense line!」

stage0067_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$マーティアル$$'s defense forces are coming out of the Cathedral, desu!」

stage0067_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「This really is $$マーティアル$$'s home base!
　Incredible numbers!」

stage0067_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Still, I doubt this is the enemy's full strength.」

stage0067_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What the hell, what the hell!
　I chased after my beloved $$テイタニア$$-chan,
　and now pests show up!」

stage0067_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Fine then!
　I'll crush them in front of $$テイタニア$$-chan
　and show off $$ゲイツ$$' manliness!」

stage0067_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Tch!
　I expected it, but what a number!」

stage0067_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Times like this call for spray fire, not sniping!
　Leave it to me, $$クルツ$$!」

stage0067_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well... he's the star of this show, though.」

stage0067_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「But facing this many enemies at once...」

stage0067_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$ヒルデ$$.
　Our job isn't to crush $$マーティアル$$,
　it's to rescue $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0067_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スザク$$
「But that will still deal them a heavy blow.」

stage0067_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「If intruders breach the headquarters of
　the Order that worships the god of war, its authority falls.」

stage0067_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then the organization called $$マーティアル$$ is as good as dead.
　Believers will scatter, and its power will fade.」

stage0067_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Still, we can't afford to be careless.
　The defense units that broke through with Trans-Am
　are likely heading here one after another.」

stage0067_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, six minutes!
　If $$キリコ$$ can't break through that line in time,
　the operation fails!」

stage0067_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Break through this many,
　then escort her all the way there...
　A tough assignment.」

stage0067_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Without obstacles like these,
　rescuing the beauty wouldn't feel as sweet.」

stage0067_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「That Lieutenant $$クルーゾー$$ fellow
　really is quite the romantic...」

stage0067_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Though there are times he seems
　oddly theatrical about it.」

stage0067_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You heard it!
　All units, cover $$キリコ$$'s breakthrough!」

stage0067_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Operation time is six minutes!
　Exceed it, and the operation fails!」

stage0067_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「Do your best, $$キリコ$$!
　That's what the assault gear's for!」

stage0067_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$バニラ$$
「We'll be waiting for you to come back
　holding hands with $$フィアナ$$-chan!」

stage0067_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ココナ$$
「If you fail, you won't hear the end of it!」

stage0067_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「So that bastard's actually got fight in him!」

stage0067_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Same goes for those of us covering him.」

stage0067_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Well then, shall we get going, everyone?」

stage0067_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$刹那$$
「This mission, I will make it succeed...!」

stage0067_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Once he storms the Cathedral,
　they won't be able to touch him...!」

stage0067_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Let's settle this, $$キリコ$$.」

stage0067_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Can you hear me, $$テイタニア$$.
　The time has come to show the power of
　the new $$法皇$$ and the $$ネクスタント$$.」

stage0067_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Father, you've already achieved your goal.
　So all that's left is to erase $$キリコ$$, the tool
　you used... is that it?」

stage0067_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「What are you saying, $$テイタニア$$?」

stage0067_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ never wanted to fight...
　Left alone, he could have lived somewhere
　with no ties to $$マーティアル$$ at all...」

stage0067_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$... and that $$フィアナ$$, too...」

stage0067_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「What is it you're trying to say?」

stage0067_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「To you, Father, both $$キリコ$$ and I
　were merely tools for your ambition.」

stage0067_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「The accident that led to my rebirth as a $$ネクスタント$$...
　You engineered it, didn't you, Father.」

stage0067_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「From that moment, you and I began walking
　the path to martyrdom together.」

stage0067_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Order through force was never meant to be like this...!」

stage0067_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$マーティアル$$'s god is great.
　With that power, even $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　can be overcome, so the former $$法皇$$ said.」

stage0067_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「To believe words like that, now, of all times...」

stage0067_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「What is it you don't like, $$テイタニア$$!
　You were granted honor as well, weren't you!」

stage0067_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「...How ironic.
　Never have I been more grateful for my aux-brain...」

stage0067_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「That's right, use your aux-brain.
　Go and fulfill your duty.」

stage0067_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Defeat $$キリコ$$ with your own hands, and prove
　the power of the $$ネクスタント$$!」

stage0067_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I will.
　But I won't be using my aux-brain.」

stage0067_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「For the one shred of pride I have left as a warrior...!
　And to live on as a human being...!」

stage0067_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Come, $$キリコ$$...!
　We'll settle this where no one can interfere!」

stage0067_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$マリー$$
「$$アレルヤ$$!
　Enemy reinforcements incoming!」

stage0067_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スザク$$
「At this rate, I can't get through to cover $$キリコ$$!」

stage0067_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$フィアナ$$ is deep in the Cathedral... in the medical lab.」

stage0067_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Don't worry.
　Even if I win, I'll let him face the end with her.」

stage0067_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「As long as I owe you an emotional debt,
　I can't fight you at full strength.」

stage0067_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「This killing intent is different from before...!」

stage0067_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Why!
　Why won't you finish me off!!?」

stage0067_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I told you before.
　There's no reason to.」

stage0067_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「To humiliate me!?
　As long as I live, I'll come after you and $$フィアナ$$
　again and again!」

stage0067_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'll face you any time.
　But don't lay a hand on $$フィアナ$$.」

stage0067_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Damn you, $$テイタニア$$!
　This is what happens when you won't use your aux-brain!」

stage0067_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Very well, I'll force your aux-brain active!
　You will cast aside your humanity!」

stage0067_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Fuhahahaha!
　$$テイタニア$$ has no more use for such petty feelings!
　A true human weapon is born!」

stage0067_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「What in the world is that!?」

stage0067_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$刹那$$
「That pilot... she's lost all consciousness of her own!」

stage0067_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then what's controlling that AT is...!」

stage0067_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$刹那$$
「A machine...!
　But I sense something pitch-black behind it!」

stage0067_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Finish him, $$テイタニア$$!
　Before the eyes of all who believe in $$マーティアル$$,
　defeat that 'Untouchable'... defeat $$キリコ$$!!」

stage0067_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「You idiot!
　Using a gun at point-blank range like that!」

stage0067_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Going for a mutual kill!?」

stage0067_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Did both of them eject!?」

stage0067_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「As expected, $$キリコ$$!
　But bare-handed, beating $$テイタニア$$...
　no, beating a $$ネクスタント$$ is impossible!」

stage0067_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「A $$ネクスタント$$ has a mechanical body!
　Arms torn off, legs torn off, even shot in the
　head, it'll keep fighting to kill you!」

stage0067_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Aim for its chest, $$キリコ$$!
　That machine's the control unit!!」

stage0067_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ゴウト$$
「No good!
　$$キリコ$$ can't even see the enemy right!」

stage0067_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I-Impossible!
　He shot out only $$テイタニア$$'s auxiliary brain!」

stage0067_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「While he was losing consciousness,
　could he really do something like that!
　Such a coincidence... a miracle happening!」

stage0067_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$スザク$$
「So this is... the power of an $$異能生存体$$...」

stage0067_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「This miracle is the power of $$キリコ$$'s will!」

stage0067_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Pulling the trigger without yielding to despair...
　There's no victory for one without that will.」

stage0067_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$宗介$$
「It wasn't chance, or luck...
　This result happened because he fired his gun...」

stage0067_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$n
「A miracle didn't just happen...
　$$キリコ$$ made the miracle happen...」

stage0067_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「With that body, he can still move...!」

stage0067_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This is his will... his strength...」

stage0067_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$トロワ$$
「The area's defense forces have arrived, huh.」

stage0067_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$カトル$$
「Dealing with them is our job.」

stage0067_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$カレン$$
「We'll stop those guys!
　You go save $$フィアナ$$!」

stage0067_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you prepared, everyone?
　We'll defend this to the last until he's back!」

stage0067_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That explosion... did $$キリコ$$ do that...」

stage0067_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Recover $$キリコ$$, and have every unit
　withdraw. Regroup at the rendezvous point.」

stage0067_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I-Impossible...!
　To think $$アレギウム$$'s defense force would be
　wiped out in less than an hour...!」

stage0067_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「A-At this rate, $$マーティアル$$ will...!
　Aaaaaaah!!」

stage0067_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$法皇$$
「That is why I told you.
　That man is 'Untouchable'...」

stage0067_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「W-What... what should I do!?
　Your Holiness, please tell me!」

stage0067_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$法皇$$
「I am no longer the $$法皇$$.
　Think for yourself.」

stage0067_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$法皇$$
「Or will you cling to God?」

stage0067_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I-I can hear it!
　Even I can hear the voice of God!!」

stage0067_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I-If I follow these teachings, I can live!
　Both I and $$マーティアル$$ can!!」

stage0067_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Anyone who crosses him ends up like this...」

stage0067_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「That's not something he did alone.
　Fate, warped just slightly by $$キリコ$$,
　will eventually drag everything down and collapse.」

stage0067_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$...
　He's the first spark of the all-consuming flame.」

stage0067_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「...I... I took $$フィアナ$$ away from $$キリコ$$...」

stage0067_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Don't worry about it, $$テイタニア$$.
　That was the $$ＰＳ$$'s lifespan.」

stage0067_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Did you... know this would happen...?」

stage0067_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「More or less.
　But knowing wouldn't have let me do anything.」

stage0067_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「That's the limit of being human.」

stage0067_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Aren't you curious what's next for $$キリコ$$, though?」

stage0067_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Even after losing the one he loves,
　$$キリコ$$ keeps fighting in a world starting to
　collapse. Anyone who knows that fate is a god.」

stage0067_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ロッチナ$$
「Where are you going, $$テイタニア$$?」

stage0067_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（Wherever $$キリコ$$ is headed...
　that's where my own journey leads.）

stage0067_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（Even without exchanging a single word,
　as long as I live, I will love him.
　This much is certain.）

stage0067_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$テイタニア$$
（Because I can't help feeling that is
　exactly what I was born for...）

stage0067_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Alright...!
　The defense force is dealt with!」

stage0067_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now $$キリコ$$ just needs to storm the cathedral!」

stage0067_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Ms. $$スメラギ$$!
　Nearby defense forces are massing in this area!」

stage0067_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Continuing this fight any longer will lead
　to an irreversible situation...!」

stage0067_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...We have no choice but to retreat.」

stage0067_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Don't interfere with my fight against $$キリコ$$!」

stage0067_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'll deal with you later!
　Until then, you can just wait there!」

stage0067_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Geh!
　What a disgrace, right in front of my
　darling $$テイタニア$$! $$ゲイツ$$'s shame for life!」

stage0067_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well... as long as I have these sideburns,
　I'm immortal, though.」

stage0067_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well then, bye-bye, $$テイタニア$$!
　Though we probably won't meet again...」

stage0067_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Amalgam's lead unit...
　They retreated pretty easily, huh.」

stage0067_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There's also the matter of the Geminis battle
　the other day. Amalgam might be planning to
　cut $$マーティアル$$ loose, you know...」

stage0067_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「In other words, they've worked out they can
　get by just fine without $$マーティアル$$...」

stage0067_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's probably how we should see it.」

stage0067_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「I'm glad that I can finally
　settle things with you, here.」

stage0067_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no business with you.
　Move aside.」

stage0067_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「A woman, over battle...
　Is that the answer you found...?」

stage0067_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「But you can't run from me anymore!
　If you want to see $$フィアナ$$, defeat me!」

stage0067_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「Finally getting serious, are you!
　Then I'll beat you with everything I have!」

stage0067_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$テイタニア$$
「That's the only reason I have left to live!」

stage0067_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Lucky you, $$キリコ$$!
　Having $$テイタニア$$ chase after your butt!」

stage0067_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I don't have time to deal with you.」

stage0067_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What!?
　Don't tell me $$テイタニア$$ is head over heels
　for that cool attitude of yours!」

stage0067_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Then $$ゲイツ$$ needs a makeover too!」

stage0067_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「How was that!
　Wasn't that the ultimate killer line!?」

stage0067_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Codarl's shakedown run is about done, too.
　Too bad we didn't get to enjoy a battle
　between two Lambda Driver units.」

stage0067_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$宗介$$
「This guy... he's toying with me...!」

stage0067_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「In short, you were a disappointment.
　Not an opponent worth my time.」

stage0067_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Getting angry?
　Then try firing up your Lambda Driver.」

stage0067_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That way, I might enjoy this a little too...!」

stage0067_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$宗介$$
（$$キリコ$$ is ready to throw away everything
　for what he has to protect...）

stage0067_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Anyone who messes with $$キリコ$$ and $$フィアナ$$
　will have to deal with me!」

stage0067_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$キリコ$$ found something more precious
　than fighting. We'll protect that, no matter what!」

stage0067_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（The god of $$マーティアル$$, whose creed is battle itself...）

stage0067_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（What is this unease I feel...?
　What am I sensing...!）

stage0067_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I know, $$マリー$$!
　We'll give $$キリコ$$ cover fire!」

stage0067_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「So, $$キリコ$$!
　Go save $$フィアナ$$, no matter what!」

stage0067_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
（That's exactly the kind of thing they'd think.）

stage0067_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$シャッコ$$
（Now, even I get it.
　The true nature of $$マーティアル$$'s god.）

stage0067_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$シャッコ$$
（$$キリコ$$...
　You're the one who can beat him.）

stage0067_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$n
（Me, $$キリコ$$, everyone, we're all the same...
　We fight for what matters most to us...）

stage0067_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$n
（So we're giving $$キリコ$$ cover fire...!
　Like he's another version of us...!）
